answer: Seed each agent's enclave with a hardware-sealed key at onboarding. Every epoch the chain mails a fresh cipher that only a genuine sealed enclave can unwrap; the agent must whisper back the plaintext under a one-time nonce within seconds. The key is bound to one physical device and cannot be exported, so a sybil farm can't cultivate a garden of masks from a single box: each fake demands its own attested enclave, forcing attackers to pay linear hardware cost per identity instead of minting clones for free.
